about: A simulated night of signed events, scored every 5 minutes by hub/app/livability.py. Made by hub/scripts/livability_replay.py.

moments.text: Fan stalls: CO₂ starts to climb
CO₂ at 2,400 ppm: one unsafe dimension caps the level
The surface level posts rehydration salts: 12's need is met
Blackout forecast: the relay drops out in ~51 min
Crew swaps the relay: power back to 230 V
Sewage backs up after the flood
A family on 35 asks for food: unmet
Morning check-ins: 34 and 35 slept 5 hours, mood low
35's check-ins: the flood spoiled stores, 2 days of food left
